guest_doc_proof_required.name: guest_doc_proof_required
guest_doc_proof_required.value: "guest_documents"."status" not in ('recu','valide') or "guest_documents"."proof_attachment_id" is not null or ("guest_documents"."proof_url" is not null and "guest_documents"."proof_url" <> '')

guest_doc_validation_trace.name: guest_doc_validation_trace
guest_doc_validation_trace.value: "guest_documents"."status" <> 'valide' or ("guest_documents"."validated_by" is not null and "guest_documents"."validated_at" is not null)
